snippet.title: Dodo Duckie - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description: Dive into the cute world of Dodo Duckie in this announcement trailer for the upcoming cozy perspective-swapping platformer game. In Dodo Duckie, embark on a journey with a duck that's trying to solve multidimensional puzzles while saving their friends from aliens. Dodo Duckie will be available on PC.
